integrity: Analytic proof with explicit completion of squares and monotone two-by-two normalization; independent Python/NumPy numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Complete strict leaf-balancing law for unweighted double-star trees only; the all-scales Gaussian criterion does not say that kernels above the power threshold are indefinite at all bandwidths. General finite-matrix criteria remain prior work; possible older equivalent tree-specific statement not ruled out exhaustively.
title: Sharp Gaussian distance-power thresholds and leaf-balancing on double-star trees
